notes: Fleet MCP tools. `roles` lists which runtime roles see the tool. Every mutation takes idempotency_key (a fresh UUID per logical action; reuse it with identical arguments to retry).

tools.name: fleet_snapshot
tools.description: Coherent snapshot of your fleet (commander) or your own task (operator): lifecycle, phases, runtimes, pending operations, artifacts, open decisions, attention items, and the snapshot revision.

task_id.description: Optional task id to scope the snapshot (commander only).

tools.name: fleet_task_create
tools.description: Create a ready task from a complete brief. Validates name grammar, kind, brief completeness, repository, dependencies (same fleet, no cycles) and resource claims. A named resource already held by an unarchived task is refused (resource-claimed, with the holder): retask that task instead of creating a replacement. Returns the task or a structured refusal.

brief.description: Complete brief text (see the brief contract).

repo.description: Primary clone path under the development root (change tasks).

base_ref.description: Explicit base ref; default is the remote default branch.

branch.description: Branch name for new work; default fleet/<fleet>/<task>.

dependencies.description: Task ids in this fleet that must be verified done first.

resources.description: Named exclusive resources this task mutates.

model.description: Exact ECA model id for the operator, taken from the catalog in your boot message. Omit for the ECA default.

variant.description: Model variant for the operator (e.g. low/medium/high/xhigh/max where the model supports it). Omit for the server default.

tools.name: fleet_task_start
tools.description: Start a ready or suspended task. Returns an operation id; completion arrives as an event (do not poll).

tools.name: fleet_task_retask
tools.description: Give a suspended/failed/blocked/done task new durable scope (a new brief revision) and make it ready to start again. If the task's operator runtime is still live but idle, Fleet stops it first and returns an operation id; completion arrives as a task-retasked event (do not poll), then call fleet_task_start. A runtime mid-turn is refused (runtime-busy): wait for its status event. Done tasks require non-empty new scope. Named resource claims stay with the task, so retask rather than create a replacement. Optional model/variant change what the next operator of this task runs on (workspace, brief history and progress.md carry over); pass them only when the user asked for a model or variant change, and an empty brief is fine when only that changes.

brief.description: New scope text; may be empty when only model/variant change on a task that is not done.

model.description: Exact ECA model id from the catalog for the next operator, or "default" to return to the configured default. Only on the user's request.

variant.description: Variant for the next operator (e.g. low/medium/high/xhigh/max where supported), or "default". Only on the user's request.

tools.name: fleet_message_send
tools.description: Queue a message to an operator's chat. Records queued/accepted/rejected/delivery-unknown truthfully; never a terminal fact about the task.

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.description: Publish your task's semantic phase: working, needs-decision (with decision), blocked, paused (with wait), done (artifacts registered), failed. Terminal phases cannot revert.

tools.name: fleet_artifact_register
tools.description: Register a named deliverable (task-relative path or external URL/ref). Not automatically verified.

task_id.description: Commander only; operators register on their own task.

tools.name: fleet_artifact_verify
tools.description: Record verification (accepted or rejected) of an artifact against the task's current brief revision and the artifact's current hash. Include criteria, evidence and limitations.

tools.name: fleet_decision_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an operator's open decision with an answer under your authority (human-authority decisions must be escalated). Delivering the answer to the operator is a separate fleet_message_send.

tools.name: fleet_external_job
tools.description: Register or update an external job that may outlive you: system, identifier, state, completion source, deadline, cancel/continue policy.

tools.name: fleet_events_pending
tools.description: Non-destructive list of unhandled events (and your already-started actions) with the current snapshot revision. Reading does not acknowledge.

tools.name: fleet_events_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge exact event ids after handling them (or durably recording a user decision), with a disposition.

tools.name: fleet_wait
tools.description: Declare a bounded wait (reason, deadline, optional external job id, who/how completion is reported). Equivalent to fleet_status paused; a single deadline-expired event follows if nothing supersedes it.

tools.name: fleet_cleanup_evidence
tools.description: Read-only preservation/ownership/quiescence evidence for a change task's workspace (single Git evidence pass).

tools.name: fleet_task_teardown
tools.description: Request normal verified teardown of a done+verified task. Returns an operation id; the result is an event. There is no force or discard option.

tools.name: fleet_operation
tools.description: Inspect an asynchronous operation by id (state, step, evidence, error). Look once if needed; completion arrives as an event.
